collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and a child aged 6-12)

collection.description: A villager builds a kite to carry notes across the village, and a child helps launch it: attach a message, or just fly it first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a dream: a kite big enough and strong enough to carry a little bark message from one end of the village to the other. It's completely unnecessary. You could just walk. (subject) knows this. (subject.He/she) has been building the kite for a week, and today (friend) is helping launch it.

choices.label: Fly It Without a Message First

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They tie on a small message: "HELLO." The kite climbs, wobbles, dives, climbs again, and comes down on a roof halfway across the village. Someone comes out, finds the message, and waves. "HELLO!" they shout back. It is, (subject) admits, slower than walking. (subject.He/she) is overjoyed.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "Let's just see if it flies," says (friend). It flies beautifully, high and steady, for a whole afternoon. They lie on their backs watching it. They forget all about the message. Neither of them minds. Tomorrow, maybe, the message. Today, just the kite.
